device.description: Path to NVRAM device (e.g., /dev/nvram). Must be readable by the asahi-wifisync process.

iwd_config_path.description: Target directory for iwd network configuration files. Must be writable by asahi-wifisync.

networks.description: List of WiFi networks to sync from NVRAM. Each item contains SSID, optional passphrase, and optional priority.

networks[].ssid.description: SSID of the network. Required field.

networks[].passphrase.description: WPA/WPA2 passphrase. Empty string means open network or already provisioned.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Valid values: debug, info, warn, error.

dry_run.description: When true, parse NVRAM and print intended config without writing to disk.
